{{Elections in Arizona}}
The '''1992 United States Senate election in Arizona''' was held on November 3. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] U.S. Senator [[John McCain]] won re-election to a second term.

==Democratic primary==
===Candidates===
* Claire Sargent, community activist<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=H9g0AAAAIBAJ&sjid=sH0DAAAAIBAJ&pg=4664,1960245&dq=claire+sargent&hl=en|title=The Prescott Courier |via=Google News Archive Search}}</ref>
* [[Truman Spangrud]], Air Force Lieutenant General

==General election==
===Candidates===
* Kiana Delamare (Libertarian)
* Ed Finkelstein (New Alliance)
* [[John McCain]], incumbent U.S. Senator (Republican)
* [[Evan Mecham]], former Governor and candidate for this seat in [[1962 United States Senate election in Arizona|1962]] (Independent)
* Claire Sargent, community activist<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=H9g0AAAAIBAJ&sjid=sH0DAAAAIBAJ&pg=4664,1960245&dq=claire+sargent&hl=en|title=The Prescott Courier |via=Google News Archive Search}}</ref> (Democratic)
* Robert B. Winn (Independent)
